summary: ITER-271 verified DIRECT-CHARGE ADD-ONS backend contract + MOBILE INVITES v3 parity + web/mobile Participants screens. Backend: 3/3 pytest passed (POST /payments/sync-plan-to-participants returns 200 {ok:false,reason:'no_active_subscription'} for cathy — sub.items 500 bug fix confirmed; POST /household/invite accepts {email,wayly_role,relationship,note} and persists relationship; POST /household/invite/{token}/resend + DELETE /household/invite/{token} both work; GET /household/members returns the full v3 shape with members, invites, capacity, pending_approvals). Mobile /family-members renders v3 layout: horizontal relationship chip row (invite-relationship-<name>), invite-email-input, invite-note-input, invite-submit-btn, members-list, invites-pending with invite-resend-<i>/invite-revoke-<i>. Mobile /participants renders participants-add-btn, pending-addon-banner + cancel-pending-addon (visible for cathy — expected because she has no real Stripe sub, per agent-to-agent note). Web /app/participants renders participants-page + participants-add-btn + pending-addon-banner and Add Participant modal opens the preview step + branch-family. No 500s and no add-flow console errors were observed on either surface.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing participants-page container testID on /participants (present on web /app/participants but not on the mobile screen root); participants-add-btn is present.

parity_issues.issue: Web exposes data-testid='participants-page' at the page root, mobile does not expose a testID='participants-page' equivalent.

action_items: OPTIONAL / LOW: Add testID='participants-page' to the root View on /app/mobile/app/participants.tsx to match the web root data-testid and simplify future parity automation.
critical_code_review_comments: payments_advanced.py correctly uses `sub['items']['data']` in 5 places (post-fix) — no residual `.items` attribute access remains. Verified by grepping the file.
sync-plan-to-participants correctly short-circuits with {ok:false, reason:'no_active_subscription'} before touching sub.items — no crash for accounts without a real Stripe subscription.
_stamp_account_addons_active is invoked in the no-change and change branches — good; will stamp legacy participant_add_ons rows on any sync call with a live subscription id.
mobile family-members.tsx sends {email, wayly_role:'caregiver', relationship, note} which matches the backend contract; success/error toasts wired to invite-error / invite-success testIDs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional; 1 low-severity missing testID on mobile

Do NOT flag that banner as a bug on cathy. rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/payments/sync-plan-to-participants raised 500 because Stripe's StripeObject inherits from dict, so `sub.items` returned dict.items (a method) instead of the SubscriptionItem list; iterating that raised. Fix applied in 5 sites in payments_advanced.py to use `sub['items']['data']`. Second issue: the web submitAdd previously called sync-plan fire-and-forget with .catch(), swallowing the 500 silently. Also fixed in Participants.jsx to await + handle {ok:false, reason:'no_active_subscription'} by falling back to /billing/v2/addon-checkout. Both fixes verified by iter271 backend test suite passing (sync-plan returns 200 with the documented shape for cathy).
